specs.title: a business is told where its work will go, before it goes anywhere
the brief says what is missing rather than writing something empty
managed access shows no balance, because there is none to show
the panel holds together in a narrow window with a long name
Settings > App updates checks, downloads, verifies and hands off
scope confirmation covers the same task; recorded actor survives a picker mutation
out-of-scope proposals wait for exact review; revocation forces exact approval again
long names hold at 800px; Stop is truthful and inspector refresh stays honest
the review explains every field and says what this build will not do
turning the setup on is something a person does, and it then says what is running
a person can go back to change an answer instead of activating
C01: the rail lists threads, carries New, marks the selection, and offers the three views
C02: the view switch swaps Thread, Board, and Team
C03: the Board shows the Ready task, and Show-me-first confirms instead of starting
C04: the palette finds and filters, Escape closes, and the Workbook keeps its own search
C05: the wake is skipped under automation
C06: the Ember scheme applies its package and token, then Field is restored
C07: the thread head states the exact-OK rule while an approval is open
Native UI: consent, exact proposal preview, approval, Review and History with an injected generator
Console task Start recovers both lost responses from state without duplicating Work
Console exact approval recovers both lost responses from durable state even with task permission
the four choices are offered honestly, and Full access says why it is not
an eligible change set is applied after a reviewer approval, recorded as a model decision
a reviewer that asks for you leaves the change set as Needs you, and you can still decide
an unavailable reviewer falls back to you, and an off connection makes the option unofferable
F01-F02: first run preserves detail and approvals, supports AI skip, and resumes
F04, F06: sample project opens and a plan edit survives reload with History
F10: plan steps become real tasks with provenance and a History entry
F11-F13: work asks twice, decline skips creation, and the remaining change is recorded
F15-F16: Review keeps the changed file and History exposes the recorded change
F07-F08: restore and Undo recover both versions; newer edits expose conflict choices
F14: Stop settles a started sample promptly and expires its approval
F17, F20-F22: surface switches preserve data; visible pages meet copy and layout checks
Draft recovery: Settings, reload and same-named files in separate projects preserve writing and stale-save conflicts
Services roster: every reported engine listed with switch discipline; Guided hides non-ready adapters; Console has no Connections
Usage: chip, signal bar and Settings bars from the test-mode snapshot
Landing: ask box carries a draft into the chosen project
Unavailable helper: the application notice has no invented runtime caption
Engine choices: the list comes from the engine, and the levels follow the choice
Modes: the Workbook composer shows four modes and Fix needs what is failing
Enter sends from the Workbook composer and Shift+Enter adds a line
Usage: navigation preserves a concurrent engine setting while refresh is delayed
the Console opens in Personal and names it where a person will see it
Personal is offered no business questions, and the old preference is explained
creating a business is explicit, and says what it actually is
the intake asks one question at a time, with a reason and a way back
a credential typed into an answer is refused where the person can read why
